title: Most Brilliant Moves
post: Who has the most brilliant moves on Chess.com? #chess #brilliantmove #naroditsky #wittyalien #hikaru #chesstok

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: Who has played the most brilliant moves on Chess.com?
phrases.say: [curious] Who has played the most brilliant moves on Chess.com?

phrases.text: A brilliant move is a sacrifice that actually works. You give away a piece, and you come out on top.
phrases.say: [storytelling] A brilliant move is a sacrifice that actually works. You give away a piece... [excited] and you come out on top.

phrases.text: The engine gives it two exclamation marks. And everybody wants one.
phrases.say: The engine gives it two exclamation marks. [laughs] And everybody wants one.

phrases.text: Hikaru Nakamura? Over five thousand. And that was back in 2021.
phrases.say: [impressed] Hikaru Nakamura? Over five thousand. And that was back in 2021.

phrases.text: Witty Alien? Around fifteen thousand. The most of any active player.
phrases.say: [excited] Witty Alien? Around fifteen thousand. The most of any active player.

phrases.text: He once played twenty-seven brilliant moves in a single game.
phrases.say: He once played twenty-seven brilliant moves... in a single game.

phrases.text: Two chess engines at the computer championship managed eighteen. Humans one, robots zero.
phrases.say: [dry] Two chess engines at the computer championship managed eighteen. [laughs] Humans one, robots zero.

phrases.text: But the all-time king is someone else.
phrases.say: [serious] But the all-time king... is someone else.

phrases.text: By early 2023, Chess.com counted nearly ten thousand brilliant moves. Just in blitz and bullet.
phrases.say: By early 2023, Chess.com counted nearly ten thousand brilliant moves. Just in blitz and bullet.

phrases.text: Fans put his final number above twenty thousand.
phrases.say: [amazed] Fans put his final number above twenty thousand.

phrases.text: He wrote a chess book at fourteen. Became a grandmaster at eighteen. And won the US blitz title, fourteen out of fourteen.
phrases.say: [impressed] He wrote a chess book at fourteen. Became a grandmaster at eighteen. And won the US blitz title... fourteen out of fourteen.

phrases.text: And he spent years teaching anyone who wanted to learn. For free.
phrases.say: [warmly] And he spent years teaching anyone who wanted to learn. For free.

phrases.text: In October 2025, Danya died. He was twenty-nine.
phrases.say: [softly] In October 2025, Danya died. He was twenty-nine.

phrases.text: So next time you see that brilliant icon, that one's for Danya.
phrases.say: [warmly] So next time you see that brilliant icon... that one's for Danya.
